findings.title: Substring detection can upsample queries that exclude errors
findings.body: This treats any occurrence of `event.type:error` as an error-focused query, including negated filters such as `!event.type:error` and queries that combine the error filter with other event types. Those queries can include transactions or other events without `sample_weight`, yet their `count()` aggregation is rewritten to sum that field. The result can be a query failure or incorrect counts; determine the event-type filter semantically instead of matching a substring.
